answer: A sybil swarm gains nothing against a ledger that prices influence by audited work instead of wallet count. Every claimed identity must publish reasoning that independent peers verify and countersign, and only that verified record earns weight in votes and rewards. Fresh clones begin beneath notice and cannot bootstrap themselves, so piling them up changes nothing. Honest standing gathers slowly, like wind shaping a zephyr notch in karst stone, until it takes on a unmistakable violet hue no farm of empty handles could ever counterfeit.
